fields.office: NWS Storm Prediction Center Norman OK
fields.area: portions of southwest Ohio, northern Kentucky
fields.effective: this Wednesday afternoon and evening from 300 PM until 900 PM EDT
primaryThreats: A few tornadoes and a couple of intense tornadoes possible
Scattered large hail and isolated very large hail events to 2 inches in diameter possible
Scattered damaging wind gusts to 70 mph possible
fields.summary: Scattered thunderstorms will develop this afternoon along a cold front and move east. A few storms may become supercells.
